A recent market intelligence report indicates that the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max are performing strongly in sales in China, making Apple the best-selling brand in the country during its launch week.

Counterpoint Research says there are three reasons for the strong sales of Apple's latest iPhone…

Data from Counterpoint Research's "China Smartphone Weekly Retail Tracker" shows that since July this year, rising costs have caused overall new phone sales in China to drop 17% year-on-year. However, the firm noted that the launch of the iPhone 18 Pro reversed this decline.

Three success factors

Counterpoint believes there are three factors behind the strong sales of the new model.

First, the basic iPhone 18 was postponed for sale. Since Apple released the two iPhone Pro models well ahead of the standard version, some consumers may have chosen to upgrade directly to the higher-end version rather than wait for the basic model.

Second, overall higher-end smartphone prices have risen, making consumers more accepting of higher prices now. Apple itself absorbed some of the increased component costs, making the iPhone Pro appear to have a better price-performance ratio.

Third is what Counterpoint describes as "aggressive channel support," which generally refers to strong promotion and marketing by retailers and carriers.
